TENEBRE.Compatibility.Title: Tenebre Resources: Compatibility Notice
TENEBRE.Compatibility.Intro: Tenebre Resources detected active modules that touch the same Foundry areas or have external compatibility risks. To avoid blocking the world, Tenebre changed or disabled some of its own integrations.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.Footer: This is not a fatal error. This notice explains which functionality may behave differently while these modules remain active.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.DoNotShowAgain: Do not show these listed notices again
TENEBRE.Compatibility.Bithir.Effect: Tenebre's bundled Bithir utilities were disabled so they do not compete for the game.bithirmod namespace with the official Bithir module. Use the official Bithir module features while it remains active.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.DragRuler.Feature: Tenebre movement ruler and movement validation
TENEBRE.Compatibility.DragRuler.Effect: Tenebre's colored movement ruler and automatic movement blocking were disabled so they do not compete with Drag Ruler. Drag Ruler controls measurement/movement while it remains active.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.TokenSounds.Effect: Token Audio FX declares Foundry minimum 14. On Foundry 13 it may fail independently from Tenebre. Tenebre does not patch this module.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.CalendariaSdm.Effe: Calendaria: SDM is active without the base Calendaria module active. Calendar features may fail until the dependency is installed/enabled.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.Tokenizers.Effect: Two tokenizer modules are active at the same time. They may duplicate menus or compete over image workflows. Tenebre only reports this and does not interfere with them.
TENEBRE.Compatibility.TabletopRpgMusic.E: Tabletop RPG Music targets an older Foundry compatibility range. Audio or playlists may fail due to that module itself. Tenebre does not patch it.

TENEBRE.Maneuvers.DelayInitiativeNote: When your turn arrives, choose another creature to act before you. Your normal initiative position is restored next turn.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.GrappleNote: Make a [Strong versus Strong] Test to prevent the target from moving. Robust grants +2 per level to both actor and target. Repeat the Test each turn to maintain the grapple; while maintaining it, you cannot perform other actions.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.DisarmNote: Attack the target's weapon or shield with [Accurate versus Strong]. The attack deals no damage; on success, the target drops the item.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.FreeAttackOnFailure: On failure, the target may make a Free Attack against you.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.KnockoutNote: Attack with Advantage and roll damage normally, but do not apply it. If 1D12 rolls below the damage result, the target is knocked unconscious.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.KnockoutAttackFirst: If the attack fails, you lose Advantage over the target. This button resolves only the knockout Test after a successful attack.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.TotalDefenseNote: During the turn, gain a second chance to pass every Defense Test, but you cannot make attacks.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.TotalOffenseNote: During the turn, gain a second chance to hit with every melee attack, but also a second chance to fail every Defense Test.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.ShoveNote: Start the turn with the Shove and spend both your combat action and movement action. A successful attack deals half damage and pushes the target half a movement (5 meters).
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.KnockdownNote: Spend your combat action and make a [Strong versus Strong] Test to knock the target down. Robust grants +2 per level. Regardless of the result, pass a Quick Test to remain standing.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.ChargeNote: Move in a straight line toward the target using double movement and make a melee attack. If the attack fails, the target may make a Free Attack against you.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.CarefulAimNote: Spend your movement action to aim with a ranged weapon. The attack Test gains a second chance to succeed; you cannot move during the turn.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.PoisonWeaponNote: Spend a combat action and pass a Cunning Test to apply poison to the weapon. The dose lasts for one hit; a result of 20 poisons you.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.TakeInitiativeNote: Make a Resolute Test. On success, gain +5 when choosing your initiative position. Success or failure, during the turn you gain a second chance to fail every Success Test; next turn, return to your normal position.
TENEBRE.Maneuvers.ManualPending: Full text pending: resolve manually until this rule is registered.

TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.flexible: On a shield, it may remain strapped to the arm while both hands are used. On armor, it reduces the Impeding value.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.bastard: May be wielded in one or two hands. When used one-handed, it loses one or more qualities and deals one-handed weapon damage.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.returning: After a missed attack, the weapon returns with a successful Accurate test made as a Free Action.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.blunt: Lacking an effective edge or point, it deals damage with an effect die one tier below normal.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.short: May be drawn as a Free Action, is easy to conceal, and works with abilities such as Feint and Backstab.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.unwieldy: Attacking requires the whole turn, spending both the Combat Action and the Movement Action.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.wrecking: Designed to destroy structures. Creatures in the area cannot use Armor; a successful Defense test halves the damage.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.concealed: Normally does not appear to be a weapon. It is identified only when actively examined and the bearer fails Discreet against Vigilant.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.balanced: Especially effective when parrying, granting +1 Defense while wielded.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.jointed: Even after a successful Defense, an odd d20 result lets the weapon hit for 1d6 damage, unaffected by abilities.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.ensnaring: May ensnare with [Accurate←Quick]. The target cannot move and has a second chance to fail tests until it breaks free.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.long: Grants one Free Attack per turn against a new melee opponent who does not wield a Long weapon.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.massive: Roll the weapon damage die twice and keep the higher result. Against a player character, Armor is rolled twice and the lower protection is used.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.precise: Grants +1 on attack tests made with this weapon.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.bloodLettin: After a damaging hit, the target loses 1 Toughness per turn. The effect is cumulative and ends with first aid or healing.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.areaMeleeRa: Affects the target and everyone immediately nearby (1–2 m radius). Defense halves damage; ongoing effects require full damage.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.areaShortRa: Affects everyone within short range, roughly a 10 m radius. Defense halves damage; ongoing effects require full damage.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.areaCone: Affects everyone in front of the weapon in a cone whose width follows the distance. Defense halves the damage.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.acidcoated: Each hit separately deals 1d4 acid damage for 1d4 turns. On a critical failure, the acid may strike the wielder.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.bane: Choose a creature group. Against that group, it deals +1d4 damage and grants +1 Vigilant to detect its presence.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.deathrune: Deals +1d4 damage to living, not thoroughly corrupt beings; it instead heals undead or thoroughly corrupt beings for 1d4.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.desecrated: A wounded target tests against Total Corruption; on failure it suffers +1d4 damage. It favors attacks against uncorrupted beings.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.flaming: A wounded target starts burning next turn for 1d4 damage during 1d4 turns. A whole turn and a Quick test may extinguish it.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.hallowed: A wounded target tests against Total Corruption; on failure it suffers +1d4 damage. It favors attacks against corrupt beings.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.poison: When the attack deals damage, the target also separately suffers 1d4 poison damage for 1d4 turns.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.thundering: Each hit separately deals 1d8 lightning damage. If it penetrates Armor, the target tests Strong or loses one action.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.mystical: The weapon counts as mystical for effects that require or distinguish mystical weapons, including certain protections and resistances.
TENEBRE.WeaponQualityTooltip.staffFighti: Marks the weapon as compatible with Staff Fighting; its effects depend on the user's ability level.
